# Media

What the client loads (TGA only; PNG masters are gitignored).

## Glass material (copies — do not edit here)

`body_mask*`, `rim5*`, `rim_dark5*`, `shadow*`, `bar_*`, `gloss`, `grain`, `sheen2`, `track_fade`:
generated by `Tools/make_textures.py`, copied from `..\GlassUnitFrames` `main`
(`git -C ..\GlassUnitFrames show main:Media/<name>.tga`). `tests/test_toc.lua` checks they exist.

## Tiles (ours, generated by a script)

`tile_covered`, `tile_exploded`, `tile_revealed`, `tile_hover`: 32x32 TGAs from
`Tools/make_tiles.py` (`python Tools/make_tiles.py --preview x.png` writes a magnified contact
sheet to look at). Shared by every tile; the generator is the source of truth. They aren't copies,
so `tests/test_toc.lua`'s drift check skips the `tile_` prefix and instead checks that every
texture the skin names exists.

## UI textures (ours, generated by a script)

`icon_flag`, `icon_clock`, `icon_trophy`, `icon_close`, `icon_arrow`, `icon_burst`, `ui_fill`, `ui_border`, `ui_glow`,
`face_ring`, `face_sparkle`, `face_soot`: `Tools/make_ui.py` (`--preview x.png` for a contact sheet).
The flag is a red pennant on a dark post (the logo's), the trophy a brass cup like the clock (the best times button), the burst sits behind the bomb on the tile that
ended the game, `ui_*` are the 9-sliced glass button parts (margin 8), the face ring and the white
icons are tinted at runtime. The generator is the source of truth.

## The mascot's face

`face_mascot`: the green-haired gnome, cut from the logo as a 64x64 circle:

    python Tools/png_to_tga.py docs/logo.png face_mascot --size 64 --circle --crop 370,60,910,600

One expression (the grin). The sparkles and soot over it are `face_sparkle` / `face_soot`; the real
expressions are #12.

## Gnomesweeper art

None else yet. The direction, palette and a prompt for each piece are in `docs/ART.md`; masters go
in `Media/Source/` (ignored by git) and `python Tools/png_to_tga.py` makes the texture.
`tests/test_media.lua` checks every texture here is a valid power-of-two 32-bit TGA. For each generated asset, record here: the file, its purpose, the generator prompt (or
script), the source master's name, and the exact conversion line, e.g.

    magick master.png -resize 64x64 -alpha on -define tga:compression=none face_ready.tga

Dimensions must be powers of two.
